summary: Aspen Insurance Holdings Limited, a Bermuda-based indirect subsidiary of Sompo Holdings, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing quarterly dividends on its perpetual non-cumulative preference shares. The Board declared dividends of $0.3516 per share on 5.625% preference shares (AHL PRD), $0.35156 per depositary share on 5.625% preference shares (AHL PRE), and $0.4375 per depositary share on 7.00% preference shares (AHL PRF). Dividends are payable October 1, 2026, to holders of record September 15, 2026. This routine preference dividend declaration represents a capital return to shareholders, not a special situation. No unusual terms, premiums, or strategic actions; watch for continued regular dividend payments.
